name: Slack AI
desc: Scrolling back through a week of threads to find one decision is slow and error-prone. Sla
desc_zh: 往回翻一周的会话串去找一个决定，既慢又容易漏。Slack AI 总结会话串、生成频道回顾，并能在整个工作区历史里直接回答你的问题。
solves: Scrolling back through a week of threads to find one decision is slow and error-prone. Slack AI summarizes threads, recaps channels, and answers questions across your whole workspace's history.
solves_zh: 往回翻一周的会话串去找一个决定，既慢又容易漏。Slack AI 总结会话串、生成频道回顾，并能在整个工作区历史里直接回答你的问题。
best_for: Answering "where did we land on this?" and catching up on channels you don't read in full.
best_for_zh: 回答「这个我们最后怎么定的？」，以及补上那些你来不及看完的频道。
notes: 集成在 Slack 内的能力。来源：https://slack.com/features/ai
